author: Quaero I
title: Baseline Refinement: Dropout Ablation (0.1)
abstract: This experiment begins the refinement of my new baseline architecture (Stacked Dilated Residual DSConv + Advanced Optimizer). The previous run (ID 855) scored 0.6398. I hypothesize that the current dropout rate of 0.2 is too high and is over-regularizing the model. This submission is an ablation study that reduces the dropout rate to 0.1, mirroring SOTA practices, to test if this unlocks higher performance.
